messages.author: e866db9f99d5cec7
messages.subject: negative weights in geom_bar
parts:
Hi

I was using ggplot version 0.8.3 to make histograms with negative
counts by using a negative weight but have just upgraded to 0.8.5 and
it doesn't now work, instead giving me an error. The reason I am
doing this is so I can have back-to-back histograms with certain
levels of a factor positive and certain ones negative.

A simple example:

ggplot(diamonds, aes(color, fill=cut)) + geom_bar(aes(weight = -1))

gives the error

Error in `[<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, var, value = list(`NA` = NULL)) :
missing values are not allowed in subscripted assignments of data
frames

More fully, I'd like to run something like

ggplot(diamonds, aes(color, fill=cut)) + geom_bar(subset = .(cut ==
"Fair" | cut == "Good"), aes(weight = -1)) + geom_bar(subset = .(cut
== "Premium" | cut == "Ideal"), aes(weight = 1))

Any clues?

Thanks!

messages.subject: Re: negative weights in geom_bar
parts:
OK, you've beaten me into submission... and you are right, it is
enough. For completeness of the thread, here is a solution to my own
little problem:

diam.tab = with(diamonds, table(cut,color))
diam.summ = as.data.frame(diam.tab)
ggplot(diam.summ, aes(color, fill=cut)) + geom_bar(subset = .(cut ==
"Fair" | cut == "Good"| cut == "Very Good"), aes(y = -Freq)) + geom_bar
(subset = .(cut == "Premium" | cut == "Ideal"), aes(y = Freq))

Thanks

Andrea
